title: Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz and the Prophecy of the Fall of Damascus and Samaria
description: The Lord commands Isaiah to write 'Swift plunder, speedy spoil' on a tablet with reliable witnesses. The prophetess bears a son named Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz, for before the boy can say 'father' and 'mother', the wealth of Damascus and the spoil from Samaria will be carried away to the king of Assyria.
